name: biotope-island
description: ブラウザで動く小さな島の生態系シミュレーション

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p worker && wrangler types worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --check
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.lint:py: uvx ruff@0.16.9 check scripts && uvx ruff@0.16.9 format --check scripts
scripts.test:scripts: uv run --no-project python -m unittest discover -s scripts
scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm run build:cloudflare && pnpm run d1:local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:acceptance: pnpm run build:acceptance && pnpm run d1:local && wrangler dev
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare: pnpm run build:cloudflare && playwright test -c playwright.cloudflare.config.ts
